description: React component for displaying and managing upsert history in a dialog, including date filtering, selection, deletion, and detailed view of history entries.

classes.name: DatePickerCustomInput
classes.description: Custom input component for date picker, styled as a button.

classes.name: UpsertHistoryRow
classes.description: Component representing a row in the upsert history table, with expandable details.

methods.name: onStartDateSelected
methods.description: Handles selection of start date, updates state, and fetches updated history.

methods.name: onEndDateSelected
methods.description: Handles selection of end date, updates state, and fetches updated history.

methods.name: handleRemoveHistory
methods.description: Deletes selected history entries and shows success/error notifications.
